verdict.rationale: The official MCP server explicitly lets any connected AI assistant 'query incidents, analyze alerts, check who's on call, manage escalations, and run deep operational analysis' via natural language, and Investigations/Suggestions features let AI agents interpret and act on incident context automatically. However, this NL-command capability is mediated through external AI assistants connecting via MCP rather than a native in-product conversational command interface, and there's no hands-on/independent validation of actually issuing free-form NL commands. missing for 10: evidence of a native in-app NL command bar/chatbot, independent hands-on proof of MCP-driven command execution, and third-party confirmation beyond vendor docs.
